reportType: non-canonical E5 response encoding and transport diagnostic

methodology.aggregation: Median of exactly three fresh-profile runs.
methodology.editorInteraction: None. Readiness is the application-owned phe:bootstrap:editor-ready mark; neither editor is focused and source-rich must remain absent.

byteDefinitions.headerAndProtocolBytes: totalEncodedBytes minus encodedBodyBytes; includes received response headers and HTTP/2 framing/accounting overhead.

methodology.phasePolicy: The additive wall-clock partition uses non-overlapping milestone intervals. Transfer elapsed is the union of first-byte to last-byte intervals, not the sum of parallel HTTP/2 requests. Bytes/200000 and CPU durations are separately labelled non-additive because transfer and main-thread initialization overlap. TLS is nested in connect and is never added to it.
